title: I’d Be Lead Harpooner on the Pequod If It Wasn’t for...
content: I’d Be Lead Harpooner on the Pequod If It Wasn’t for These DEI Hires. “I’m just telling you that it’s getting hard out there for us blue-collar Nantucket lads when all the ships’ owners are catching the Abolitionist Mind Virus.”
author: Jason Kottke
